issues.gist: Anthropic, the maker of the Claude chatbot, made its Nasdaq debut after the largest IPO on record, raising $81.3 billion at $83 a share. Shares opened at $111.50, valuing the company near $2 trillion, before slipping to about $95 as investors weighed AI debt, politics and safety.

issues.easyKo: AI 회사 앤스로픽이 주식시장에 처음 나와 사상 최대인 813억 달러를 모았어요. 첫날 주가가 공모가보다 크게 올랐다가 일부 내렸고, 투자자들은 AI 거품 우려와 안전 약속을 함께 지켜보고 있어요.

views.view: The record raise is a crucial test for AI, but investors question whether the loss-making firm can keep pace as huge obligations fall due.
Analyst Dan Ives calls the debut an A-plus success and a vote of confidence in the tech trade.
The debut shows strong appetite despite bubble fears, while the pace of enterprise adoption remains the long-term question.
Strategists say the strong IPO helps AI sentiment but does not settle worries about rates, Nvidia's turmoil and Washington.
The listing could make Anthropic's circular financing self-sustaining, leaving it with a huge war chest.
It stresses ballooning losses and early investor Dustin Moskovitz's warning about an unchecked AI race.
Shares popped then pulled back in a volatile debut, with protesters outside the Nasdaq warning about pension funds.
Morningstar is positive on Anthropic's position at the frontier but warns of a wide range of financial outcomes.

paragraphs.en: Anthropic, the San Francisco company behind the Claude chatbot, began trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday after pricing the largest initial public offering ever recorded. Shares opened at $111.50 under the ticker symbol ANT, roughly 34% above the $83 offer price, which lifted its market value to about $2 trillion. That level outpaced SpaceX, whose value hit $1.96 trillion at its opening trade in June, and only a handful of US-listed firms are worth more. The surge did not last, however, as the stock touched a high of $114.99 around midday before sliding to roughly $95 in the afternoon. Even so, Dan Ives, a tech analyst at Yorkville Ives & Co., called the debut an "A-plus success" in comments to CBS News.
paragraphs.ko: 앤스로픽은 목요일 나스닥에서 거래를 시작했고, 주가는 공모가 83달러보다 약 34% 높은 111.50달러로 시작해 시가총액 약 2조 달러에 닿았어요. 그러나 최고 114.99달러를 찍은 뒤 오후에는 약 95달러까지 내려갔고, 댄 아이브스는 "A+ 성공"이라고 평가했어요.

paragraphs.en: The company raised $81.3 billion in the offering, surpassing the $75 billion that Elon Musk's SpaceX collected when it listed in June. Overwhelming demand pushed Anthropic to lift its price from an initial range of $70 to $78 and to sell about 980 million Class A shares, up from a planned 825 million. Roughly 956 million of those shares came from the company itself, while each of the seven co-founders sold about 3.38 million shares, for a combined $1.96 billion that does not flow to Anthropic. A separate $26 billion private placement with companies including Google, Microsoft and Nvidia lifts the total haul to about $107 billion, and underwriters such as Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley hold a 30-day option on 147 million more shares. One early investor told the BBC, on condition of anonymity, that the original sale was heavily oversubscribed, with demand ten times the number of shares available.
paragraphs.ko: 앤스로픽은 813억 달러를 조달해 스페이스X의 750억 달러 기록을 넘었어요. 수요가 몰려 공모가와 물량을 늘렸고, 창업자 일곱 명은 각각 약 338만 주를 팔았으며, 별도 사모 투자 260억 달러를 더하면 총 약 1,070억 달러예요. 주관사단은 1억 4,700만 주를 더 살 권리가 있고, 한 초기 투자자는 수요가 물량의 열 배였다고 했어요.

sents.en: The company raised $81.3 billion in the offering, surpassing the $75 billion that Elon Musk's SpaceX collected when it listed in June.
sents.ko: 회사는 이번 공모로 813억 달러를 모아, 6월 상장 때 일론 머스크의 스페이스X가 거둔 750억 달러를 넘어섰어요.

sents.en: Overwhelming demand pushed Anthropic to lift its price from an initial range of $70 to $78 and to sell about 980 million Class A shares, up from a planned 825 million.
sents.ko: 압도적인 수요 때문에 앤스로픽은 처음 제시한 70~78달러 범위보다 가격을 올렸고, 계획했던 8억 2,500만 주보다 많은 약 9억 8,000만 주의 클래스A 주식을 팔았어요.

sents.en: Roughly 956 million of those shares came from the company itself, while each of the seven co-founders sold about 3.38 million shares, for a combined $1.96 billion that does not flow to Anthropic.
sents.ko: 그 가운데 약 9억 5,600만 주는 회사가 팔았고, 공동 창업자 일곱 명은 각각 약 338만 주를 팔아 합계 19억 6,000만 달러를 챙겼으며 이 돈은 앤스로픽에 들어가지 않아요.

sents.en: A separate $26 billion private placement with companies including Google, Microsoft and Nvidia lifts the total haul to about $107 billion, and underwriters such as Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley hold a 30-day option on 147 million more shares.
sents.ko: 구글, 마이크로소프트, 엔비디아 등과 맺은 260억 달러 규모의 사모 투자까지 더하면 총 조달액은 약 1,070억 달러이고, 골드만삭스와 모건스탠리 같은 주관사단은 30일 동안 1억 4,700만 주를 더 살 수 있는 권리를 가져요.

sents.en: One early investor told the BBC, on condition of anonymity, that the original sale was heavily oversubscribed, with demand ten times the number of shares available.
sents.ko: 한 초기 투자자는 익명을 조건으로 BBC에 처음 공모가 크게 초과 청약되어 수요가 물량의 열 배였다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: At the $83 offer price, the company was valued at about $1.5 trillion on a diluted basis, a measure that takes employee stock options into account. On a basic share count, the BBC reported, Anthropic is worth about $1.1 trillion, more than Walmart and Samsung but less than Tesla and Meta. Only about 7.4% of the shares are available for public trading, according to Renaissance Capital, or up to 9.8% if Class A shares held by non-founder employees are included. The seven co-founders, who each hold a stake of roughly 3.6% to 3.7% of the voting common shares, saw their paper wealth jump to around $20 billion apiece. They are Dario Amodei, his sister Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish and Christopher Olah, and many employees are expected to become millionaires as well.
paragraphs.ko: 공모가 기준 회사 가치는 희석 기준 약 1조 5,000억 달러, 기본 주식 수 기준 약 1조 1,000억 달러예요. 일반 거래 가능 물량은 약 7.4%(최대 9.8%)이고, 창업자 일곱 명은 각각 약 200억 달러의 장부상 재산을 갖게 됐으며 많은 직원이 백만장자가 될 전망이에요.

sents.en: At the $83 offer price, the company was valued at about $1.5 trillion on a diluted basis, a measure that takes employee stock options into account.
sents.ko: 공모가 83달러 기준으로 회사 가치는 직원 스톡옵션을 반영한 희석 기준 약 1조 5,000억 달러였어요.

sents.en: On a basic share count, the BBC reported, Anthropic is worth about $1.1 trillion, more than Walmart and Samsung but less than Tesla and Meta.
sents.ko: BBC에 따르면 기본 주식 수로 따지면 앤스로픽의 가치는 약 1조 1,000억 달러로, 월마트와 삼성보다 크지만 테슬라와 메타보다는 작아요.

sents.en: Only about 7.4% of the shares are available for public trading, according to Renaissance Capital, or up to 9.8% if Class A shares held by non-founder employees are included.
sents.ko: 르네상스 캐피털에 따르면 일반 거래가 가능한 주식은 약 7.4%에 불과하며, 창업자가 아닌 직원이 가진 클래스A 주식까지 넣으면 최대 9.8%예요.

sents.en: The seven co-founders, who each hold a stake of roughly 3.6% to 3.7% of the voting common shares, saw their paper wealth jump to around $20 billion apiece.
sents.ko: 의결권 있는 보통주의 약 3.6~3.7%씩을 가진 공동 창업자 일곱 명의 장부상 재산은 각각 약 200억 달러로 뛰었어요.

sents.en: They are Dario Amodei, his sister Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish and Christopher Olah, and many employees are expected to become millionaires as well.
sents.ko: 이들은 다리오 아모데이, 그의 여동생 다니엘라 아모데이, 톰 브라운, 잭 클라크, 재러드 캐플런, 샘 매캔들리시, 크리스토퍼 올라이며, 많은 직원도 백만장자가 될 것으로 보여요.

paragraphs.en: Revenue has ballooned, with the prospectus showing $33.24 billion in the first nine months of 2026, about 1,200% more than a year earlier, driven largely by the coding tool Claude Code, according to The Decoder. Annualized revenue had reached roughly $81 billion by the end of October, and TechCrunch cited $17 billion in third-quarter revenue. Losses are enormous too, as the net loss for the nine months widened to $104 billion from $25.1 billion a year earlier, mostly because of revaluations of convertible notes and derivative liabilities. As of Sept. 30 the company carried $6.2 billion in debt, and it has signed deals requiring about $900 billion in spending on computing power and infrastructure, including $70 billion over the next 12 months. Analysts at SemiAnalysis estimate that Anthropic needs about $280 billion in cumulative revenue over four years to pay that compute bill, a target they call achievable, and the company is expected to hold about $220 billion in cash and short-term investments after the offering.
paragraphs.ko: 투자설명서상 9개월 매출은 332억 4,000만 달러(약 1,200% 증가)이고 순손실은 1,040억 달러로 커졌어요. 부채는 62억 달러이며 약 9,000억 달러를 인프라에 쓰기로 했고, 분석가들은 4년간 누적 매출 약 2,800억 달러가 필요하되 달성 가능하다고 봐요. 공모 뒤 현금은 약 2,200억 달러가 될 전망이에요.

sents.en: Revenue has ballooned, with the prospectus showing $33.24 billion in the first nine months of 2026, about 1,200% more than a year earlier, driven largely by the coding tool Claude Code, according to The Decoder.

sents.en: Annualized revenue had reached roughly $81 billion by the end of October, and TechCrunch cited $17 billion in third-quarter revenue.
sents.ko: 10월 말에는 연환산 매출이 약 810억 달러에 이르렀고, 테크크런치는 3분기 매출이 170억 달러라고 인용했어요.

sents.en: Losses are enormous too, as the net loss for the nine months widened to $104 billion from $25.1 billion a year earlier, mostly because of revaluations of convertible notes and derivative liabilities.
sents.ko: 손실도 어마어마해서, 9개월 순손실은 1년 전 251억 달러에서 1,040억 달러로 커졌고 대부분 전환사채와 파생부채의 재평가 때문이에요.

sents.en: As of Sept. 30 the company carried $6.2 billion in debt, and it has signed deals requiring about $900 billion in spending on computing power and infrastructure, including $70 billion over the next 12 months.
sents.ko: 9월 30일 기준 회사의 부채는 62억 달러였고, 컴퓨팅 파워와 인프라에 약 9,000억 달러를 쓰도록 하는 계약을 맺었으며 여기에는 앞으로 12개월간 700억 달러가 포함돼요.

sents.en: Analysts at SemiAnalysis estimate that Anthropic needs about $280 billion in cumulative revenue over four years to pay that compute bill, a target they call achievable, and the company is expected to hold about $220 billion in cash and short-term investments after the offering.
sents.ko: 세미애널리시스 분석가들은 앤스로픽이 이 컴퓨팅 비용을 내려면 4년간 누적 매출 약 2,800억 달러가 필요하다고 추산하며 달성 가능한 목표라고 보고, 공모 뒤 회사는 현금과 단기 투자자산 약 2,200억 달러를 가질 전망이에요.

paragraphs.en: TechCrunch noted that Amazon and Google, two of Anthropic's largest infrastructure partners, hold stakes worth a combined $307.9 billion at the $83 price, with Amazon's 14.7% stake valued at up to $159 billion and Google's 13.7% stake at nearly $149 billion. Nvidia, AMD, Microsoft, Broadcom, Micron and TSMC joined Google in the $26 billion private placement, and most of them are also suppliers that Anthropic has agreed to buy from. Skeptics call this circular financing, because the cloud giants appear to get their money straight back when Anthropic trains a model or serves Claude to users. Gil Luria of D.A. Davidson argued that the listing changes this, because Anthropic will take home about $91.7 billion in net proceeds and "they're not burning cash", and Joey Brookhart of SemiAnalysis said the stake owners no longer need to prop the company up. Both analysts agreed that the biggest risk is simply losing the AI race, and Luria warned that if everyone used other people's models, Anthropic would be "worth nothing".
paragraphs.ko: 아마존과 구글의 지분은 83달러 기준 합계 3,079억 달러이고, 엔비디아 등 공급사도 사모 투자에 참여해 순환 금융 논란이 있어요. 루리아와 브룩하트는 상장으로 이 구조가 자립하게 된다고 보면서도, 가장 큰 위험은 AI 경쟁에서 지는 것이라고 했어요.

sents.en: TechCrunch noted that Amazon and Google, two of Anthropic's largest infrastructure partners, hold stakes worth a combined $307.9 billion at the $83 price, with Amazon's 14.7% stake valued at up to $159 billion and Google's 13.7% stake at nearly $149 billion.
sents.ko: 테크크런치는 앤스로픽의 최대 인프라 파트너인 아마존과 구글의 지분이 83달러 기준 합계 3,079억 달러이며, 아마존의 14.7%는 최대 1,590억 달러, 구글의 13.7%는 약 1,490억 달러에 이른다고 지적했어요.

sents.ko: 엔비디아, AMD, 마이크로소프트, 브로드컴, 마이크론, TSMC가 구글과 함께 260억 달러 사모 투자에 참여했고, 이들 대부분은 앤스로픽이 제품을 사기로 한 공급사이기도 해요.

sents.en: Skeptics call this circular financing, because the cloud giants appear to get their money straight back when Anthropic trains a model or serves Claude to users.
sents.ko: 회의론자들은 이를 순환 금융이라 부르는데, 앤스로픽이 모델을 훈련하거나 사용자에게 클로드를 제공할 때 클라우드 대기업들이 투자금을 곧바로 돌려받는 것처럼 보이기 때문이에요.

sents.en: Gil Luria of D.A. Davidson argued that the listing changes this, because Anthropic will take home about $91.7 billion in net proceeds and "they're not burning cash", and Joey Brookhart of SemiAnalysis said the stake owners no longer need to prop the company up.
sents.ko: D.A. 데이비슨의 길 루리아는 상장이 이 구조를 바꾼다며 앤스로픽이 순수익금 약 917억 달러를 챙기고 "현금을 태우고 있지 않다"고 주장했고, 세미애널리시스의 조이 브룩하트는 지분 보유사들이 더는 회사를 떠받칠 필요가 없다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Both analysts agreed that the biggest risk is simply losing the AI race, and Luria warned that if everyone used other people's models, Anthropic would be "worth nothing".
sents.ko: 두 분석가는 가장 큰 위험이 단순히 AI 경쟁에서 지는 것이라는 데 동의했고, 루리아는 모두가 남의 모델을 쓰게 되면 앤스로픽은 "가치가 없다"고 경고했어요.

paragraphs.en: The debut came at a jittery moment, as the tech-heavy Nasdaq has fallen more than 11% since early October and AI-linked shares have swung sharply on worries about debt, politics and Nvidia's leadership. Democrats, who now control both chambers of Congress after the midterm elections, are expected to be tougher on AI, and some candidates opposed the data centers needed to run it. Minutes of the Federal Reserve's October meeting also flagged concern about AI-related debt financed through "complex and opaque" structures, and one strategist said some Fed policymakers are discussing a 50-basis-point rate hike in December. Market reaction was muted, with the Nasdaq up 0.1% after rising as much as 2% at the open and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, while the 10-year Treasury yield held at 5.066%. Strategists were split: Sam Grelck of Truist said the IPO is not a verdict on AI, Talley Leger urged patience for retail buyers, and Joe Zidle of Cresset said the debate had moved from "Is this real?" to "Who captures the value?"
paragraphs.ko: 나스닥이 10월 초 이후 11% 넘게 하락한 불안한 시기에 상장이 이뤄졌어요. 민주당의 의회 장악, 연준의 AI 부채 우려, 금리 인상 논의가 부담이었고 시장 반응은 잔잔했으며, 전략가들의 시각은 갈렸어요.

sents.en: The debut came at a jittery moment, as the tech-heavy Nasdaq has fallen more than 11% since early October and AI-linked shares have swung sharply on worries about debt, politics and Nvidia's leadership.
sents.ko: 이번 데뷔는 불안한 시점에 이뤄졌는데, 기술주 중심의 나스닥이 10월 초 이후 11% 넘게 떨어졌고 AI 관련 주식은 부채, 정치, 엔비디아 경영진 문제로 크게 출렁였어요.

sents.en: Democrats, who now control both chambers of Congress after the midterm elections, are expected to be tougher on AI, and some candidates opposed the data centers needed to run it.
sents.ko: 중간선거 뒤 의회 양원을 장악한 민주당은 AI에 더 엄격할 것으로 예상되고, 일부 후보는 AI를 돌리는 데 필요한 데이터센터에 반대했어요.

sents.en: Minutes of the Federal Reserve's October meeting also flagged concern about AI-related debt financed through "complex and opaque" structures, and one strategist said some Fed policymakers are discussing a 50-basis-point rate hike in December.
sents.ko: 연방준비제도의 10월 회의록도 "복잡하고 불투명한" 구조로 조달한 AI 관련 부채를 우려했고, 한 전략가는 일부 연준 위원이 12월 0.5%포인트 금리 인상을 논의 중이라고 말했어요.

sents.en: Market reaction was muted, with the Nasdaq up 0.1% after rising as much as 2% at the open and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, while the 10-year Treasury yield held at 5.066%.
sents.ko: 시장 반응은 잔잔해서, 나스닥은 개장 직후 최대 2% 오른 뒤 0.1% 상승에 그쳤고 S&P 500은 0.4% 내렸으며 10년물 미국 국채 수익률은 5.066%로 변함이 없었어요.

sents.en: Strategists were split: Sam Grelck of Truist said the IPO is not a verdict on AI, Talley Leger urged patience for retail buyers, and Joe Zidle of Cresset said the debate had moved from "Is this real?" to "Who captures the value?"
sents.ko: 전략가들의 시각은 갈렸어요. 트루이스트의 샘 그렐크는 이번 상장이 AI에 대한 판결은 아니라고 했고, 탤리 레저는 개인 투자자에게 인내를 권했으며, 크레셋의 조 지들은 논쟁이 "이게 진짜인가?"에서 "누가 가치를 차지하나?"로 옮겨 갔다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: Dario Amodei and his sister Daniela rang the opening bell, and he read a speech from a printout that began with the loss of their father to a disease that became curable just a few years later. He said sufficiently powerful AI, working in concert with humans, could compress a century of scientific and medical progress into a decade, while admitting that so far there are only early results. Amodei listed the risks as misuse by individuals or nation-states, economic disruption and losing control of AI systems, and argued that they are avoidable if safeguards are in place. "We will pace the training and deployment of AI systems," he said, adding that the company "will not bend to either business nor political pressure" and that the listing only "strengthens our resolve to do the right thing". His sister told CNBC that the risks are real but the promise of AI is also "incredible", and TechCrunch noted that OpenAI's Sam Altman, Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis and Elon Musk have said they agree with his September call to pace development, though few concrete commitments have followed.
paragraphs.ko: 다리오 아모데이는 개장 종 연설에서 AI가 한 세기의 의학·과학 발전을 10년으로 압축할 수 있다고 말하면서도 오남용, 경제적 혼란, 통제력 상실 위험을 인정했어요. 그는 AI의 훈련과 배포 속도를 조절하고 압력에 굴하지 않겠다고 다짐했고, 경쟁사 수장들도 동의했지만 구체적 약속은 거의 없었어요.

sents.en: Dario Amodei and his sister Daniela rang the opening bell, and he read a speech from a printout that began with the loss of their father to a disease that became curable just a few years later.
sents.ko: 다리오 아모데이와 여동생 다니엘라가 개장 종을 쳤고, 그는 출력한 원고로 연설을 시작하며 아버지가 몇 년 뒤 치료 가능해진 병으로 돌아가셨다는 이야기를 했어요.

sents.en: He said sufficiently powerful AI, working in concert with humans, could compress a century of scientific and medical progress into a decade, while admitting that so far there are only early results.
sents.ko: 그는 충분히 강력한 AI가 사람과 함께 일하면 한 세기의 과학·의학 발전을 10년으로 압축할 수 있다고 하면서도, 지금은 초기 결과만 있다고 인정했어요.

sents.en: Amodei listed the risks as misuse by individuals or nation-states, economic disruption and losing control of AI systems, and argued that they are avoidable if safeguards are in place.
sents.ko: 아모데이는 위험으로 개인이나 국가의 오남용, 경제적 혼란, AI 시스템 통제력 상실을 꼽으면서, 안전장치가 있으면 피할 수 있다고 주장했어요.

sents.en: "We will pace the training and deployment of AI systems," he said, adding that the company "will not bend to either business nor political pressure" and that the listing only "strengthens our resolve to do the right thing".
sents.ko: 그는 "AI 시스템의 훈련과 배포의 속도를 조절하겠다"고 말하며, 회사가 "사업적 압력에도 정치적 압력에도 굴하지 않을 것"이고 상장이 "옳은 일을 하겠다는 결의를 더 굳게 한다"고 덧붙였어요.

sents.en: His sister told CNBC that the risks are real but the promise of AI is also "incredible", and TechCrunch noted that OpenAI's Sam Altman, Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis and Elon Musk have said they agree with his September call to pace development, though few concrete commitments have followed.
sents.ko: 여동생은 CNBC에 위험이 현실이지만 AI의 가능성도 "놀랍다"고 말했고, 테크크런치는 오픈AI의 샘 올트먼, 구글 딥마인드의 데미스 허사비스, 일론 머스크가 개발 속도를 조절하자는 그의 9월 제안에 동의했다고 했지만 구체적 약속은 거의 없었다고 짚었어요.

paragraphs.en: The listing is not without controversy, and Dustin Moskovitz, a Facebook co-founder who put between $15 million and $25 million into Anthropic's first funding round in 2021, has distanced himself from it. He told The New York Times that he and his wife, Cari Tuna, "invested in Anthropic to promote safety, not racing", and they moved their stake to a nonprofit in early 2025 to avoid profiting from the IPO. Earlier this year Anthropic also clashed with the Pentagon, which wanted unrestricted military use of its models, after Amodei refused to cross lines on fully autonomous weapons and mass surveillance of Americans. The Pentagon then labeled the company a "supply chain risk", a designation previously reserved for foreign adversaries, and the prospectus devotes more than 90 pages to risk factors, including the chance that people lose control of AI. OpenAI, meanwhile, has confidentially filed for an IPO planned for 2027, and outside the Nasdaq building a small #StopTechOligarchs protest warned that the offering endangers workers' pension funds.
paragraphs.ko: 초기 투자자 더스틴 모스코비츠는 상장과 거리를 두며 안전을 위해 투자했다고 말했어요. 앤스로픽은 올해 국방부와 충돌해 "공급망 위험"으로 지정됐고, 투자설명서는 위험 요인에 90쪽 넘게 할애했어요. 오픈AI는 2027년 기업공개를 신청했고, 현장에서는 작은 시위도 있었어요.

sents.en: The listing is not without controversy, and Dustin Moskovitz, a Facebook co-founder who put between $15 million and $25 million into Anthropic's first funding round in 2021, has distanced himself from it.
sents.ko: 상장은 논란이 없지 않은데, 2021년 첫 투자 라운드에 1,500만~2,500만 달러를 넣은 페이스북 공동 창업자 더스틴 모스코비츠가 거리를 두고 있어요.

sents.en: He told The New York Times that he and his wife, Cari Tuna, "invested in Anthropic to promote safety, not racing", and they moved their stake to a nonprofit in early 2025 to avoid profiting from the IPO.
sents.ko: 그는 뉴욕 타임스에 자신과 아내 캐리 튜나가 "경쟁이 아니라 안전을 촉진하려고 앤스로픽에 투자했다"고 말했고, 상장으로 이익을 보지 않으려고 2025년 초 지분을 비영리 단체로 옮겼어요.

sents.en: Earlier this year Anthropic also clashed with the Pentagon, which wanted unrestricted military use of its models, after Amodei refused to cross lines on fully autonomous weapons and mass surveillance of Americans.
sents.ko: 올해 초 앤스로픽은 국방부와도 충돌했는데, 국방부가 모델의 제한 없는 군사 사용을 원했지만 아모데이가 완전 자율 무기와 미국인 대규모 감시라는 선을 넘길 수 없다고 했기 때문이에요.

sents.en: The Pentagon then labeled the company a "supply chain risk", a designation previously reserved for foreign adversaries, and the prospectus devotes more than 90 pages to risk factors, including the chance that people lose control of AI.
sents.ko: 이후 국방부는 이 회사를 그동안 외국 적대 세력에만 쓰던 "공급망 위험"으로 지정했고, 투자설명서는 사람들이 AI 통제력을 잃을 가능성을 포함해 위험 요인에 90쪽 넘게 할애했어요.

sents.en: OpenAI, meanwhile, has confidentially filed for an IPO planned for 2027, and outside the Nasdaq building a small #StopTechOligarchs protest warned that the offering endangers workers' pension funds.
sents.ko: 한편 오픈AI는 2027년으로 예정된 기업공개를 비공개로 신청했고, 나스닥 건물 밖에서는 작은 #StopTechOligarchs 시위대가 이번 공모가 노동자 연금을 위태롭게 한다고 경고했어요.

paragraphs.en: The offering also reaches Korea, where the benchmark KOSPI ended up 1.39% at 5,137.89 on Thursday as investors weighed whether heavy AI spending will pay off ahead of the Anthropic debut, according to Yonhap. Samsung Electronics rose 1.13% to 196,900 won and SK hynix jumped 3.41% to 1,183,000 won, while the won firmed to 1,330 against the dollar from 1,333 the previous session. In the United States, ABC News said the stock will almost certainly find its way into 401(k) retirement accounts, because the Nasdaq adopted a May rule allowing fast entry into the Nasdaq-100 for some major IPOs. An analyst at Edward Jones added that Anthropic is unlikely to join the S&P 500 before late 2027 because of eligibility requirements. Investors will now watch how the shares trade once the first quarterly reports arrive, and a Truist study found that more than half of 32 of the biggest IPOs ever saw their shares slide by at least 50% at some point in their first year.
paragraphs.ko: 한국에서는 코스피가 1.39% 오른 5,137.89에 마감했고 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스도 올랐어요. 미국에서는 앤스로픽이 나스닥100 신속 편입 규정 덕에 401(k) 계좌에 곧 들어갈 전망이고, 역대 대형 공모주의 절반 넘게가 첫해 한때 50% 이상 빠졌다는 조사도 있어 투자자들이 첫 분기 실적을 지켜볼 거예요.

sents.en: The offering also reaches Korea, where the benchmark KOSPI ended up 1.39% at 5,137.89 on Thursday as investors weighed whether heavy AI spending will pay off ahead of the Anthropic debut, according to Yonhap.
sents.ko: 이번 공모는 한국에도 닿았는데, 연합뉴스에 따르면 투자자들이 앤스로픽 데뷔를 앞두고 막대한 AI 투자가 결실을 볼지 가늠하는 가운데 대표 지수 코스피가 목요일 1.39% 오른 5,137.89에 마감했어요.

sents.en: Samsung Electronics rose 1.13% to 196,900 won and SK hynix jumped 3.41% to 1,183,000 won, while the won firmed to 1,330 against the dollar from 1,333 the previous session.
sents.ko: 삼성전자는 1.13% 올라 19만 6,900원, SK하이닉스는 3.41% 뛴 118만 3,000원이 됐고, 원화는 전 거래일 1,333원에서 달러당 1,330원으로 강해졌어요.

sents.en: In the United States, ABC News said the stock will almost certainly find its way into 401(k) retirement accounts, because the Nasdaq adopted a May rule allowing fast entry into the Nasdaq-100 for some major IPOs.
sents.ko: 미국에서는 ABC 뉴스가, 나스닥이 5월에 일부 대형 공모주의 나스닥100 지수 신속 편입을 허용하는 규정을 도입해 이 주식이 401(k) 은퇴 계좌에 곧 들어갈 것이 거의 확실하다고 전했어요.

sents.en: An analyst at Edward Jones added that Anthropic is unlikely to join the S&P 500 before late 2027 because of eligibility requirements.

issues.titleKo: 세계 최고 법원이 미얀마가 로힝야에게 집단학살을 저질렀다고 획기적으로 판결했어요.
issues.gist: The International Court of Justice ruled by nine votes to six that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, the first such finding against a state. It ordered abuses halted and reparations paid, though it cannot enforce its decision.
issues.gistKo: 국제사법재판소가 9대 6으로 미얀마가 소수민족 로힝야에게 집단학살을 저질렀다고 판결했고, 한 국가에 이 범죄의 책임을 물은 것은 처음이에요. 재판소는 미얀마에 학대를 멈추고 가해자를 처벌하고 배상하라고 명령했지만 이를 집행할 수단은 없어요.
issues.easyKo: 유엔의 최고 법원이 미얀마 군이 로힝야 사람들을 없애려는 의도로 학살했다고 처음으로 한 나라에 책임을 물었어요. 판결은 확정이지만 법원에 강제할 힘이 없어서 안전보장이사회와 국제사회의 압박이 다음 관건이에요.

views.view: The genocide finding is a landmark, but political conditions in Myanmar mean relief for the Rohingya is unlikely anytime soon.
The ruling is without precedent and was welcomed by Rohingya and rights groups, though the court cannot imprison officials.
The court held that Myanmar breached its duty to prevent and not to commit genocide and recognised the Rohingya as a protected group.
The judgment sets a precedent for genocide claims, notably the Gaza case, after judges rejected Myanmar's counter-terrorism claims.
Relief at The Hague and in the camps, but what happens next is in the hands of governments, and a safe return remains unlikely.

talk.answer: I think it can, because the ruling gives the Rohingya official recognition that the military committed genocide. paragraphs.en: The International Court of Justice ruled on Thursday that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, delivering a historic verdict that ended a legal battle lasting seven years. Nine of the court’s fifteen judges found that the country had committed genocide, and the decision, which cannot be appealed, was read aloud by the court’s president, Yuji Iwasawa of Japan, over more than two hours. The ruling is the first time in the World Court’s history, since its founding in 1945, that a state has been held responsible for committing genocide. The case was brought in 2019 by The Gambia, a small, Muslim-majority West African nation, which had itself only recently emerged from years of repression under the dictator Yahya Jammeh.
paragraphs.ko: 국제사법재판소는 목요일 미얀마가 소수민족 로힝야에 대해 집단학살을 저질렀다고 판결했어요. 7년에 걸친 법적 다툼이 마무리된 역사적 판결이에요. 재판관 15명 가운데 9명이 미얀마가 집단학살을 저질렀다고 보았고, 항소할 수 없는 이 판결은 일본 출신 이와사와 유지 재판소장이 두 시간 넘게 낭독했어요. 1945년 설립된 국제사법재판소 역사상 한 국가가 집단학살을 저지른 책임이 있다고 판단된 것은 이번이 처음이에요. 이 사건은 2019년 서아프리카의 작은 무슬림 다수 국가 감비아가 제기했어요. 감비아도 독재자 야히아 잠메의 수년간 탄압에서 막 벗어난 나라였어요.

paragraphs.en: In its judgment, the court said that “genocidal intent is the only reasonable inference that can be drawn from the evidence,” concluding that Myanmar’s actions reflected an intention to destroy a substantial part of the Rohingya population. Judge Iwasawa said Myanmar’s security forces had killed thousands of Rohingya civilians, committed widespread sexual violence, inflicted extreme violence on children and attacked people as they tried to flee. The court determined that around 10,000 Rohingya were violently killed during the 2017 operation, that more than 700,000 are thought to have fled to Bangladesh, and that roughly 815,000 had been targeted in some way. Villages were “systematically destroyed,” replaced with permanent structures and then resettled by people who were not Rohingya, while the military also burned or disposed of bodies and bulldozed sites to carry out what the judges called “extensive destruction of evidence.”
paragraphs.ko: 재판소는 판결문에서 “집단학살의 의도가 증거에서 끌어낼 수 있는 유일하게 합리적인 추론”이라며, 미얀마의 행위가 로힝야 인구의 상당 부분을 파괴하려는 의도를 보여 준다고 결론 내렸어요. 이와사와 재판관은 미얀마 보안군이 수천 명의 로힝야 민간인을 죽이고, 광범위한 성폭력을 저지르고, 아이들에게 극단적인 폭력을 가했으며, 달아나는 사람들까지 공격했다고 말했어요. 재판소는 2017년 작전 중 약 1만 명의 로힝야가 폭력적으로 목숨을 잃었고, 70만 명 넘게 방글라데시로 피란한 것으로 보이며, 약 81만 5천 명이 어떤 식으로든 표적이 되었다고 판단했어요. 마을은 “조직적으로 파괴”된 뒤 영구 건축물로 대체되고 로힝야가 아닌 사람들이 다시 들어와 살았으며, 군은 시신을 불태우거나 처리하고 현장을 불도저로 밀어 재판관들이 말한 “광범위한 증거 인멸”도 저질렀어요.

paragraphs.en: The judges also found that senior officials had spread hate speech portraying the Rohingya as “subhuman” and “a violent threat,” and that this campaign overlapped with the military’s so-called clearance operations, making violence against the group more likely. Legal experts regard the judgment as a key test for how sexual violence is treated in genocide cases, because the 1948 convention lists acts intended to “prevent births” among the ways such a crime can be committed. The court accused the military of using sexual violence to impair the willingness and ability of the Rohingya to procreate, and said that limits of two children per Rohingya family were discriminatory measures meant to restrict births. Antonia Mulvey of Legal Action Worldwide told the BBC that the court had not accepted Myanmar’s counter-terrorism defence and had found for the first time that rape and sexual violence can be an act of genocide.
paragraphs.ko: 재판관들은 고위 관리들이 로힝야를 “인간 이하”이자 “폭력적 위협”으로 그리는 혐오 발언을 퍼뜨렸고, 이 선전이 이른바 소탕 작전과 겹치면서 이 집단에 대한 폭력 가능성을 높였다고 보았어요. 1948년 협약이 집단학살의 방식 가운데 하나로 “출생을 막으려는” 행위를 꼽기 때문에, 법률 전문가들은 이번 판결을 집단학살 사건에서 성폭력을 어떻게 다루는지 보여 주는 중요한 시험대로 봐요. 재판소는 군이 로힝야의 출산 의지와 능력을 해치려고 성폭력을 사용했다고 비난했고, 로힝야 가정에 자녀를 두 명으로 제한한 것은 출생을 억제하려는 차별적 조치라고 말했어요. 리걸 액션 월드와이드의 안토니아 멀비는 BBC에, 재판소가 미얀마의 대테러 항변을 받아들이지 않았고 강간과 성폭력이 집단학살 행위가 될 수 있다고 처음으로 판단했다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: The court further held that Myanmar had violated its obligation to prevent genocide, noting that its military knew of the risk when armed civilians and allied militias joined the campaign, and that it made no meaningful effort to restrain them. Iwasawa said some civilian participation could not necessarily be treated as state-ordered, and he lamented that Myanmar’s refusal to investigate or share evidence meant the court might lack reliable knowledge available only from inside the country. The judges additionally recognised the Rohingya as a distinct ethnic group with their own language and culture, a status that Myanmar, which calls them Bengalis or foreign migrants, has long denied.
paragraphs.ko: 재판소는 또 무장 민간인과 동맹 민병대가 작전에 가담했을 때 군이 위험을 알고 있었고 이들을 막으려는 의미 있는 노력도 하지 않았다며, 미얀마가 집단학살을 막을 의무를 어겼다고 판단했어요. 이와사와 재판관은 일부 민간인의 가담을 반드시 국가가 지시한 것으로 볼 수는 없다고 했고, 미얀마가 조사와 증거 제공을 거부해 재판소가 국내에서만 알 수 있는 믿을 만한 정보를 갖지 못했을 가능성이 있다고 아쉬움을 나타냈어요. 재판관들은 또 로힝야가 고유한 언어와 문화를 지닌 별개의 민족 집단임을 인정했어요. 로힝야를 벵골인이나 외국 이주민이라 부르는 미얀마가 오랫동안 부인해 온 지위예요.

sents.en: The court further held that Myanmar had violated its obligation to prevent genocide, noting that its military knew of the risk when armed civilians and allied militias joined the campaign, and that it made no meaningful effort to restrain them.

paragraphs.en: Turning to remedies, the court ordered Myanmar to cease all acts of violence, to investigate those who are culpable, to prosecute and punish the guilty, and to guarantee that such crimes will never be repeated. It also ordered restitution and reparations, which campaigners have long demanded, including the safe and voluntary return of the Rohingya, the replacement of damaged collective property, a search for the disappeared and proper burials, and physical and psychological rehabilitation. The judges said they could not set the amount of compensation themselves and instructed Myanmar to submit within two years a report outlining its plan, which sets a deadline of November 2028.
paragraphs.ko: 구제 조치와 관련해 재판소는 미얀마에 모든 폭력 행위를 멈추고, 책임이 있는 사람들을 조사하고, 유죄인 사람들을 기소해 처벌하며, 이런 범죄가 다시는 되풀이되지 않도록 보장하라고 명령했어요. 재판소는 활동가들이 오래 요구해 온 원상회복과 배상도 명령했어요. 로힝야의 안전하고 자발적인 귀환, 훼손된 공동 재산의 반환 또는 대체, 실종자 수색과 제대로 된 장례, 신체적·심리적 회복 지원이 포함돼요. 재판관들은 보상액을 스스로 정할 수 없다며, 미얀마에 2년 안에 계획을 담은 보고서를 내라고 했어요. 그 기한은 2028년 11월이에요.

paragraphs.en: Myanmar has consistently denied the accusation, arguing that its “clearance operations” were a lawful response to attacks by the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army, a militant group that struck more than 30 police posts in Rakhine State in 2017. At the hearings in January, Myanmar’s representative, Ko Ko Hlaing, told the court the country “was not obliged to remain idle and allow terrorists to have free reign,” and after the verdict he said he had “no comment.” The military regime, now led by Min Aung Hlaing, who commanded the crackdown and later seized power in a 2021 coup, gave no immediate public response, while the shadow National Unity Government said it “respects the authority” of the court.
paragraphs.ko: 미얀마는 “소탕 작전”이 2017년 라카인주 경찰 초소 30곳 넘게를 공격한 무장단체 아라칸 로힝야 구원군에 대한 합법적 대응이었다며 줄곧 혐의를 부인해 왔어요. 1월 심리에서 미얀마 대표 코 코 흘라잉은 나라가 “가만히 앉아 테러범들이 마음대로 날뛰게 둘 의무는 없다”고 말했고, 판결 뒤에는 “할 말이 없다”고 했어요. 당시 탄압을 지휘했고 2021년 쿠데타로 권력을 잡은 민 아웅 흘라잉이 이끄는 군부는 곧바로 공식 반응을 내지 않았고, 그림자 정부인 국민통합정부는 재판소의 “권위를 존중한다”고 밝혔어요.

paragraphs.en: The Rohingya, a largely Muslim group concentrated in Rakhine State on the Bangladesh border, numbered about 1.4 million in Myanmar before 2017, where they were a minority among 137 recognised ethnic groups. Although they say they are Indigenous to the country, the government regards them as “illegal migrants” from Bangladesh, and a 1982 citizenship law left most of them stateless, a policy that successive governments, including Aung San Suu Kyi’s from 2016 to 2021, continued. After the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army attacks in August 2017, the military launched a sweeping offensive in which, survivors said, soldiers shot men dead, raped women and razed villages, and a UN fact-finding mission concluded in 2019 that the army had committed “genocidal acts.” Around 1.2 million Rohingya now live in crowded camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, the world’s largest refugee settlement, while an estimated 520,000 remain in Myanmar under severe restrictions.
paragraphs.ko: 로힝야는 방글라데시와 국경을 맞댄 라카인주에 주로 사는 대체로 무슬림인 집단으로, 2017년 이전 미얀마에 약 140만 명이 살았고 인정된 137개 민족 가운데 소수였어요. 로힝야는 자신들이 이 땅의 토착민이라고 하지만 정부는 이들을 방글라데시에서 온 “불법 이주민”으로 보고 있어요. 1982년 시민권법으로 대부분이 무국적자가 됐고, 2016~2021년 아웅산 수치 정부를 포함한 역대 정부가 이를 이어 갔어요. 2017년 8월 아라칸 로힝야 구원군의 공격 이후 군은 대규모 공세에 나섰고, 생존자들은 군인들이 남자들을 총으로 쏘고 여자들을 성폭행하고 마을을 쓸어버렸다고 말했어요. 2019년 유엔 진상조사단은 군이 “집단학살 행위”를 저질렀다고 결론 내렸어요. 현재 로힝야 약 120만 명이 세계 최대 난민 정착지인 방글라데시 콕스바자르의 붐비는 캠프에 살고, 약 52만 명은 심한 제약 속에 미얀마에 남아 있는 것으로 추정돼요.

paragraphs.en: When the case was heard in 2019, Suu Kyi, a Nobel Peace Prize winner who was later overthrown, travelled to The Hague herself and called The Gambia’s claims “incomplete and misleading,” a defence that left many Rohingya deflated. In January 2020 the court nonetheless ordered Myanmar to take emergency measures to prevent genocide, a decision experts called a “stunning rebuke,” and eleven countries, among them Canada, Britain, France and Germany, later applied to support the case. The Gambia, backed by the 57-member Organisation of Islamic Cooperation, was represented at the final hearings in January by its justice minister, Dawda Jallow, who told the judges the case was about “real people, real stories.” In closed-door sessions, the court also heard from survivors who had travelled from the camps in Bangladesh.
paragraphs.ko: 2019년 심리 당시 노벨 평화상 수상자로 나중에 축출된 수치 여사는 직접 헤이그까지 가서 감비아의 주장이 “불완전하고 오해의 소지가 있다”고 반박했고, 이 변호는 많은 로힝야를 낙담하게 했어요. 그럼에도 재판소는 2020년 1월 미얀마에 집단학살을 막는 긴급 조치를 취하라고 명령했는데, 전문가들은 이를 “놀라운 질책”이라고 불렀어요. 이후 캐나다·영국·프랑스·독일 등 11개국이 사건을 지지하겠다고 신청했어요. 57개 회원국을 둔 이슬람협력기구의 지지를 받은 감비아는 1월 마지막 심리에서 다우다 잘로 법무장관이 대표로 나섰고, 이 사건은 “실제 사람들, 실제 이야기”에 관한 것이라고 재판관들에게 말했어요. 재판소는 비공개 심리에서 방글라데시 캠프에서 온 생존자들의 이야기도 들었어요.

paragraphs.en: In The Hague, Rohingya survivors wept and called relatives in the camps as soon as they left the courtroom, and Salma, a 30-year-old survivor who lost family members in 2017, said: “Everyone worked hard and struggled for this justice.” In Cox’s Bazar, crowds who watched the translated verdict on outdoor screens leaped to their feet, applauding, and many held posters reading “Thank You Gambia” and “Justice = Safe Return.” Yousuf Ali, a survivor who travelled to the court, said: “Today, we have finally been heard, and it is a profound relief,” but added that the fight was not over. Farida Khatun, 50, whose village of Tula Toli was destroyed in a 2017 massacre, said the verdict made her happy but that she doubted Myanmar would take the refugees back in true peace. Gambia’s Jallow told reporters: “The victory belongs to the Rohingya. They survived. They testified. And today, they will believe.”
paragraphs.ko: 헤이그에서는 로힝야 생존자들이 법정을 나서자마자 울음을 터뜨리며 캠프의 가족들에게 전화를 걸었어요. 2017년 가족을 잃은 30세 생존자 살마는 “모두가 이 정의를 위해 애쓰고 싸웠다”고 말했어요. 콕스바자르에서는 야외 화면으로 번역된 판결을 지켜보던 사람들이 벌떡 일어나 박수를 쳤고, 많은 이들이 “감비아 고마워요”와 “정의 = 안전한 귀환”이라고 적힌 팻말을 들었어요. 법정까지 간 생존자 유수프 알리는 “오늘 우리는 마침내 목소리를 인정받았고, 깊은 안도감이 든다”면서도 싸움이 끝난 것은 아니라고 덧붙였어요. 2017년 학살로 마을 툴라톨리가 파괴된 50세 파리다 카툰은 판결이 기쁘지만 미얀마가 진정한 평화 속에 난민들을 받아들일지는 믿기 어렵다고 말했어요. 감비아의 잘로 장관은 기자들에게 “승리는 로힝야의 것이다. 그들은 살아남았고, 증언했고, 오늘 믿게 될 것이다”라고 말했어요.

sents.en: In The Hague, Rohingya survivors wept and called relatives in the camps as soon as they left the courtroom, and Salma, a 30-year-old survivor who lost family members in 2017, said: “Everyone worked hard and struggled for this justice.”

sents.en: In Cox’s Bazar, crowds who watched the translated verdict on outdoor screens leaped to their feet, applauding, and many held posters reading “Thank You Gambia” and “Justice = Safe Return.”
sents.ko: 콕스바자르에서는 야외 화면으로 번역된 판결을 지켜보던 사람들이 벌떡 일어나 박수를 쳤고, 많은 이들이 “감비아 고마워요”와 “정의 = 안전한 귀환”이라고 적힌 팻말을 들었어요.

sents.en: Yousuf Ali, a survivor who travelled to the court, said: “Today, we have finally been heard, and it is a profound relief,” but added that the fight was not over.
sents.ko: 법정까지 간 생존자 유수프 알리는 “오늘 우리는 마침내 목소리를 인정받았고, 깊은 안도감이 든다”면서도 싸움이 끝난 것은 아니라고 덧붙였어요.

sents.en: Farida Khatun, 50, whose village of Tula Toli was destroyed in a 2017 massacre, said the verdict made her happy but that she doubted Myanmar would take the refugees back in true peace.
sents.ko: 2017년 학살로 마을 툴라톨리가 파괴된 50세 파리다 카툰은 판결이 기쁘지만 미얀마가 진정한 평화 속에 난민들을 받아들일지는 믿기 어렵다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Gambia’s Jallow told reporters: “The victory belongs to the Rohingya. They survived. They testified. And today, they will believe.”
sents.ko: 감비아의 잘로 장관은 기자들에게 “승리는 로힝야의 것이다. 그들은 살아남았고, 증언했고, 오늘 믿게 될 것이다”라고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called the verdict a “powerful recognition of the Rohingya victims of genocide,” and UN human rights chief Volker Türk said the suffering inflicted on them was a “stain on the conscience of humanity” that must now “translate into real action.” Britain’s foreign secretary, Ed Miliband, announced that his government would expel Myanmar’s defence attaché, summon its chargé d’affaires and press urgently for a session of the UN Security Council, the body empowered to enforce ICJ rulings. He promised to set out further action in the coming days after a cross-party group of British MPs urged the government to resume sanctions against Myanmar’s military. Matthew Smith of the advocacy group Fortify Rights called it “a huge day for the Rohingya people and all people of Myanmar,” and Arsalan Suleman, The Gambia’s lead counsel, described the judgment as “a landmark victory.”
paragraphs.ko: 안토니우 구테흐스 유엔 사무총장은 이번 판결을 “집단학살 피해자인 로힝야에 대한 강력한 인정”이라고 했고, 폴커 튀르크 유엔 인권최고대표는 그들이 겪은 고통이 “인류 양심의 얼룩”이며 이제 “실제 행동으로 옮겨져야 한다”고 말했어요. 영국의 에드 밀리밴드 외무장관은 정부가 미얀마 국방 무관을 추방하고 대리대사를 불러들이며, 국제사법재판소 판결을 집행할 권한이 있는 유엔 안전보장이사회의 긴급 회의를 요구하겠다고 밝혔어요. 그는 영국 여야 의원 모임이 정부에 미얀마 군부에 대한 제재를 재개하라고 촉구한 뒤, 며칠 안에 추가 조치를 내놓겠다고 약속했어요. 옹호 단체 포티파이 라이츠의 매슈 스미스는 “로힝야와 미얀마 모든 사람들에게 엄청난 날”이라고 했고, 감비아의 수석 변호인 아르살란 술레만은 판결을 “획기적 승리”라고 불렀어요.

paragraphs.en: The verdict carries unusual weight because the 1948 Genocide Convention requires proof of a specific intent to destroy a national, ethnic, racial or religious group, a standard so difficult to meet that the court had never before held a state responsible. In 2007 the court found that Serbia had failed to prevent or punish genocide committed by Bosnian Serb troops at Srebrenica, but it concluded that the state itself had not committed the act, and another Balkan case likewise fell short. Other UN tribunals have established genocide in only a handful of cases since the Holocaust, among them Cambodia’s Khmer Rouge rule in the 1970s and the mass killings in Rwanda in 1994. Philippe Sands, a leading human rights lawyer who helped bring the case, said it was “right up there with the great moments of international justice: Nuremberg, Pinochet, and others.”
paragraphs.ko: 1948년 집단학살방지협약은 민족·인종·종교 집단을 파괴하려는 구체적 의도의 증명을 요구하는데, 이 기준이 매우 충족하기 어려워 재판소는 그동안 한 번도 국가의 책임을 인정한 적이 없었어요. 그래서 이번 판결의 무게가 남달라요. 재판소는 2007년 세르비아가 스레브레니차에서 보스니아 세르비아계 군대가 저지른 집단학살을 막지도 처벌하지도 못했다고 판단했지만 국가가 직접 저지른 것은 아니라고 보았고, 발칸 전쟁을 다룬 다른 사건도 마찬가지로 직접 책임에는 이르지 못했어요. 그 밖에 유엔 재판소들이 홀로코스트 이후 집단학살을 인정한 사례는 1970년대 캄보디아 크메르루주 통치와 1994년 르완다 대학살 등 손에 꼽을 정도예요. 이 사건을 제기하는 데 참여한 저명 인권 변호사 필리프 상스는 이번 판결이 “뉘른베르크, 피노체트 재판 같은 국제 정의의 위대한 순간들과 어깨를 나란히 한다”고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: Yet the court is not a criminal tribunal, it cannot send officials to prison, and it relies on the Security Council and political pressure to impose its decisions, although The Gambia could now raise the case there and ask for action. Individual accountability lies with the International Criminal Court, where prosecutors in 2024 sought an arrest warrant for Min Aung Hlaing over the mass deportation of the Rohingya, an application that was still pending. Min Aung Hlaing, who toppled Suu Kyi’s elected government in 2021, triggering a civil war, was installed as civilian president in April after elections that were widely discredited. Matthew Smith said the ruling would give “much-needed momentum” to efforts to hold the perpetrators and architects of the genocide individually criminally accountable.
paragraphs.ko: 하지만 재판소는 형사재판소가 아니라서 관리들을 감옥에 보낼 수 없고, 결정을 관철하려면 안전보장이사회와 정치적 압력에 기대야 해요. 다만 감비아는 이제 안보리에 사건을 올려 조치를 요청할 수 있어요. 개인 책임은 국제형사재판소의 몫인데, 검찰은 2024년 로힝야 집단 추방과 관련해 민 아웅 흘라잉에 대한 체포영장을 청구했고 이 신청은 아직 계류 중이에요. 2021년 수치의 선출 정부를 무너뜨려 내전을 촉발한 민 아웅 흘라잉은 널리 신뢰를 잃은 선거를 거쳐 4월 민간인 대통령으로 취임했어요. 매슈 스미스는 이번 판결이 집단학살의 실행자와 설계자에게 개인적 형사 책임을 묻는 노력에 “꼭 필요한 추진력”을 줄 것이라고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: The decision is also being read closely in the Gaza case that South Africa has brought against Israel, which the Guardian said could be affected because judges dismissed Myanmar’s claim of legitimate counter-insurgency operations. Sands told the BBC that the Gaza case had been “the elephant in the room” during the Myanmar hearings and that, had Myanmar not been found responsible, the case against Israel “would, in effect, be over,” though a ruling against Myanmar does not mean the court will find similarly on Gaza. Israel says the case against it is “wholly unfounded.” The Guardian added that the verdict was predicted to lead the United States to impose sanctions on ICJ judges, including this year’s Nobel Peace Prize winner, Navi Pillay, noting that the Trump administration had already sanctioned the International Criminal Court.
paragraphs.ko: 이번 결정은 남아프리카공화국이 이스라엘을 상대로 제기한 가자 사건에서도 주의 깊게 읽히고 있어요. 가디언은 재판관들이 미얀마의 정당한 대반란 작전 주장을 기각한 점이 그 사건에 영향을 줄 수 있다고 전했어요. 상스는 BBC에 미얀마 심리 내내 가자 사건이 “방 안의 코끼리”였고 미얀마가 책임을 면했다면 이스라엘 사건은 “사실상 끝났을 것”이라고 했어요. 다만 미얀마에 불리한 판결이 가자에 대해서도 같은 판단이 나온다는 뜻은 아니라고 덧붙였어요. 이스라엘은 자국을 상대로 한 사건이 “전혀 근거가 없다”고 말해요. 가디언은 이번 판결이 미국이 올해 노벨 평화상 수상자 나비 필레이를 포함한 국제사법재판소 재판관들을 제재하는 결과로 이어질 것으로 예상된다고 전하며, 트럼프 행정부가 이미 국제형사재판소를 제재했다고 덧붙였어요.

sents.ko: 가디언은 이번 판결이 미국이 올해 노벨 평화상 수상자 나비 필레이를 포함한 국제사법재판소 재판관들을 제재하는 결과로 이어질 것으로 예상된다고 전하며, 트럼프 행정부가 이미 국제형사재판소를 제재했다고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: For the refugees, a safe return remains very uncertain, since the 2021 coup set off a civil war that has killed an estimated 100,000 people and displaced more than 3.5 million, and fighting between the army and the Arakan Army, a largely Buddhist rebel group, has worsened conditions in Rakhine. In August Myanmar said it had verified more than 300,000 refugees in Bangladesh for repatriation, although it insisted that returns could begin only once security was restored in Rakhine, and aid for the Rohingya has shrunk, especially since President Donald Trump slashed foreign aid spending in January 2025. Michael Becker, an international law professor at Trinity College Dublin and a former ICJ legal officer, had cautioned before the ruling that political conditions in Myanmar were not amenable to delivering relief anytime soon. Kyaw Min Sabber of the Rohingya Human Rights Initiative urged the Gambia and its supporters to keep up the pressure until the Rohingya can return “with full equal rights, security, and dignity,” and attention now turns to whether and how Myanmar will submit its report by the November 2028 deadline.
paragraphs.ko: 난민들이 안전하게 돌아가는 일은 여전히 매우 불확실해요. 2021년 쿠데타가 내전을 불러 약 10만 명이 숨지고 350만 명 넘게 집을 잃었고, 군과 대체로 불교도인 반군 아라칸군 사이의 전투가 라카인의 상황을 더 악화시켰기 때문이에요. 미얀마는 8월 방글라데시의 난민 30만 명 넘게를 송환 대상으로 확인했다고 밝혔지만 라카인의 치안이 회복돼야 송환을 시작할 수 있다고 못 박았어요. 로힝야 지원도 줄었는데, 특히 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 2025년 1월 해외 원조를 대폭 삭감한 뒤 그랬어요. 트리니티 칼리지 더블린의 국제법 교수이자 전직 국제사법재판소 법률 담당관 마이클 베커는 판결 전에, 미얀마의 정치 상황이 조만간 구제를 실현하기에 적합하지 않다고 경고했어요. 로힝야 인권 이니셔티브의 쿄 민 사버는 감비아와 지지국들이 로힝야가 “완전히 평등한 권리와 안전과 존엄을 갖고” 돌아갈 수 있을 때까지 압박을 이어가라고 촉구했어요. 이제 관심은 미얀마가 2028년 11월 기한까지 보고서를 낼지, 어떻게 낼지에 쏠려 있어요.

issues.title: AI Infrastructure Spending Nears $2.4 Trillion as Bubble Fears, ECB and IMF Warnings Shadow Anthropic's Record IPO
issues.titleKo: AI 인프라 지출이 2조 4천억 달러에 육박하는 가운데 거품 우려와 ECB 경고, IMF의 금리 경고가 앤스로픽의 사상 최대 상장에 그림자를 드리워요
issues.gist: Global AI infrastructure spending is forecast to near $2.4 trillion next year, even as the ECB and IMF warn of debt-fuelled valuations and higher interest rates. Anthropic's record Nasdaq debut has become the test of whether investors still believe in the boom.
issues.gistKo: 내년 전 세계 AI 인프라 지출이 2조 4천억 달러에 가까워질 전망인데, ECB와 IMF는 부채에 기댄 가치 평가와 금리 상승을 경고해요. 앤스로픽의 사상 최대 나스닥 상장은 투자자가 아직 호황을 믿는지 가르는 시험대가 됐어요.
issues.easyKo: AI에 쓰는 돈이 내년에 엄청나게 늘 거라는 전망이 나왔어요. 하지만 빚으로 투자하는 게 위험하다는 경고도 나와요. 앤스로픽이 주식시장에 상장해 큰돈을 모은 것이 이 호황이 이어질지 보여 주는 시험이에요.

views.view: Anthropic's IPO could revive the boom or mark its last gasp, since success will not ease unease over AI economics and circular financing.
Wall Street is growing cautious about AI outlay, though some analysts call the sell-off a healthy correction in the early innings of the build-out.
Ambitious AI earnings expectations and debt-funded infrastructure leave markets vulnerable to abrupt adjustments and loss spillovers.
The IMF chief says AI demand is lifting prices and calls for tighter monetary policy, while stressing that AI is here to stay.
An Acadian manager says US stocks are probably in a dot-com-style bubble, though valuations could stay elevated for years.
Samsung's Kim Yong-kwan says neocloud debt is a limited share of the market and that AI investment rests on real demand.
Debt funds nearly 60% of the AI buildout, and a low-productivity shock could cost shareholders and creditors $16.8 trillion.
Spending is showing signs of slowing as firms ask whether returns justify outlays and whether cheaper, lighter models will suffice.

talk.q: Do you think the AI investment boom is a bubble, and why?
talk.qKo: AI 투자 호황이 거품이라고 생각하나요? 왜 그런가요?
talk.answer: The numbers are huge, with Gartner expecting $2.4 trillion in AI infrastructure spending next year. But the ECB warns that much of it is funded through debt, so I think there are real risks. Still, analysts such as Kit Rees call the recent sell-off a healthy correction, so I would watch revenue growth before calling it a bubble.
talk.answerKo: 숫자가 엄청나요. 가트너는 내년 AI 인프라 지출을 2조 4천억 달러로 봐요. 하지만 ECB는 상당 부분이 부채로 조달된다고 경고해서 실제 위험이 있다고 생각해요. 그래도 키트 리스 같은 분석가는 최근 급락을 건전한 조정이라 하니, 거품이라 부르기 전에 매출 성장을 지켜보겠어요.

paragraphs.en: Global spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure is projected to reach about $2.4 trillion next year, up 53% from 2026, according to a report that Gartner released on Nov. 19. That sum would represent 59% of all global AI spending, which Gartner expects to climb 47.5% to $4 trillion, so infrastructure is growing faster than the rest of the market. The biggest driver is AI-optimized servers, where spending is forecast to surge 81.4%, from $527.6 billion this year to $957.2 billion, as hyperscalers and neocloud providers rush to add capacity. Gartner analyst John-David Lovelock said demand for scaling inference workloads is growing faster than anticipated, while training workloads are also becoming more compute-intensive.
paragraphs.ko: 내년 AI 인프라 지출이 약 2조 4천억 달러로 53% 늘 것이라는 가트너 전망이에요. 전체 AI 지출 4조 달러의 59%이며, AI 서버 지출은 81.4% 급증해 9,572억 달러가 된다고 해요. 추론 수요가 예상보다 빠르게 늘고 학습 작업도 더 많은 연산을 요구한다는 설명이에요.

sents.en: Global spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure is projected to reach about $2.4 trillion next year, up 53% from 2026, according to a report that Gartner released on Nov. 19.
sents.ko: 가트너가 11월 19일 낸 보고서에 따르면 내년 전 세계 인공지능 인프라 지출은 올해보다 53% 늘어 약 2조 4천억 달러에 이를 전망이에요.

sents.en: That sum would represent 59% of all global AI spending, which Gartner expects to climb 47.5% to $4 trillion, so infrastructure is growing faster than the rest of the market.
sents.ko: 이 금액은 가트너가 47.5% 늘어 4조 달러가 될 것으로 보는 전 세계 AI 지출 전체의 59%에 해당해서, 인프라가 나머지 시장보다 빠르게 크고 있어요.

sents.en: The biggest driver is AI-optimized servers, where spending is forecast to surge 81.4%, from $527.6 billion this year to $957.2 billion, as hyperscalers and neocloud providers rush to add capacity.
sents.ko: 가장 큰 동력은 AI에 맞춘 서버로, 대형 클라우드 업체와 신생 클라우드 업체가 설비를 서둘러 늘리면서 지출이 올해 5,276억 달러에서 9,572억 달러로 81.4% 급증할 것으로 예상돼요.

sents.en: Gartner analyst John-David Lovelock said demand for scaling inference workloads is growing faster than anticipated, while training workloads are also becoming more compute-intensive.
sents.ko: 가트너의 존데이비드 러벨록 분석가는 추론 작업을 키우려는 수요가 예상보다 빨리 늘고 있고 학습 작업도 점점 더 많은 연산을 요구한다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: Part of the increase reflects price rather than volume, because a phenomenon the report calls memflation, in which climbing memory chip prices lift server unit costs, is becoming more pronounced. Software spending is forecast to rise 42% and AI services 29.5%, as companies embed AI features in existing programs and hire providers to help with strategy, data preparation and system integration. The market for generative AI models is expected to grow 82% to $51 billion, with spending on domain-specific models for law, healthcare and finance jumping 99%, though foundation models should still account for 81%.
paragraphs.ko: 증가분 일부는 메모리 값 상승(메모리플레이션)이 서버 단가를 올린 탓이에요. 소프트웨어 지출은 42%, AI 서비스는 29.5% 늘고, 생성형 AI 모델 시장은 82% 커져 510억 달러가 될 전망이에요. 분야별 모델은 99% 늘지만 기반 모델이 81%를 차지해요.

sents.en: Part of the increase reflects price rather than volume, because a phenomenon the report calls memflation, in which climbing memory chip prices lift server unit costs, is becoming more pronounced.
sents.ko: 증가분의 일부는 물량이 아니라 가격 때문인데, 보고서가 메모리플레이션이라 부르는 현상, 즉 메모리 반도체 값이 오르며 서버 단가를 끌어올리는 일이 두드러지고 있어요.

sents.en: Software spending is forecast to rise 42% and AI services 29.5%, as companies embed AI features in existing programs and hire providers to help with strategy, data preparation and system integration.
sents.ko: 기업들이 기존 소프트웨어에 AI 기능을 넣고 전략 수립, 데이터 준비, 시스템 통합을 맡길 업체를 쓰면서 소프트웨어 지출은 42%, AI 서비스 지출은 29.5% 늘 전망이에요.

sents.en: The market for generative AI models is expected to grow 82% to $51 billion, with spending on domain-specific models for law, healthcare and finance jumping 99%, though foundation models should still account for 81%.
sents.ko: 생성형 AI 모델 시장은 82% 성장해 510억 달러가 될 것으로 보이며, 법률 · 의료 · 금융 같은 분야별 모델 지출은 99% 뛰지만 기반 모델이 여전히 81%를 차지할 전망이에요.

paragraphs.en: Counterpoint Research noted that a circular investment model is taking hold, in which infrastructure providers fund model developers that in turn buy their infrastructure, speeding the buildout while deepening mutual dependence in financing, demand and supply. The BBC's business editor, Simon Jack, described a similar web, pointing out that Anthropic has agreements to buy or lease hundreds of billions of dollars of chips and computing power from firms such as Broadcom, Google and Amazon. Many of those firms are also investors in Anthropic and major customers of its products, he wrote, which makes the financial links hard to untangle.
paragraphs.ko: 카운터포인트리서치는 인프라 업체가 모델 개발사에 돈을 대고 그 개발사가 다시 인프라를 사는 순환 구조가 굳어지고 있다고 했어요. BBC도 앤스로픽이 브로드컴, 구글, 아마존과 수천억 달러 규모 계약을 맺었고 이들이 투자자이자 고객이라고 짚었어요.

sents.en: Counterpoint Research noted that a circular investment model is taking hold, in which infrastructure providers fund model developers that in turn buy their infrastructure, speeding the buildout while deepening mutual dependence in financing, demand and supply.
sents.ko: 카운터포인트리서치는 인프라 업체가 모델 개발사에 자금을 대고 그 개발사가 다시 그 인프라를 사는 순환 투자 구조가 자리 잡고 있다고 했어요. 이는 구축을 빠르게 하지만 자금, 수요, 공급에서 서로 얽힘을 깊게 해요.

sents.en: The BBC's business editor, Simon Jack, described a similar web, pointing out that Anthropic has agreements to buy or lease hundreds of billions of dollars of chips and computing power from firms such as Broadcom, Google and Amazon.
sents.ko: BBC 경제 에디터 사이먼 잭도 비슷한 그물을 짚으며, 앤스로픽이 브로드컴, 구글, 아마존 같은 회사에서 수천억 달러어치 칩과 컴퓨팅 능력을 사거나 빌리기로 계약했다고 했어요.

sents.en: Many of those firms are also investors in Anthropic and major customers of its products, he wrote, which makes the financial links hard to untangle.
sents.ko: 그 회사들 가운데 상당수가 앤스로픽의 투자자이자 주요 고객이기도 해서 재무적 연결을 풀어 보기 어렵다고 그는 썼어요.

paragraphs.en: Against that backdrop, Anthropic made its Nasdaq debut on Thursday in what DW called the largest share sale on record, offering 980 million shares at $83 each before trading opened 34% higher at $111.50. The opening price valued the five-year-old company at roughly $2 trillion, well above market estimates of about $1.3 trillion, while the Guardian put its expected value at $1.5 trillion despite reported losses of $80 billion in the first half of 2026. The BBC reported that about $81 billion of shares were offered to the public and a further $26 billion to other big technology companies, comfortably the biggest money-raising event in American corporate history, with orders reportedly more than six times the shares on offer. Analysts at StoneX described it as the first chance for public investors to buy a pure play on an AI provider, since earlier listings concerned chip makers and data centre builders.
paragraphs.ko: 앤스로픽이 목요일 나스닥에 데뷔했어요. 9억 8천만 주를 83달러에 내놓았고 거래는 111.50달러에서 시작해 가치가 약 2조 달러로 매겨졌어요. BBC는 일반에 약 810억 달러, 다른 기술 기업에 260억 달러가 배정됐고 주문이 6배를 넘었다고 전했어요. 스톤엑스는 AI 업체 자체에 투자할 첫 기회라고 했어요.

sents.en: Against that backdrop, Anthropic made its Nasdaq debut on Thursday in what DW called the largest share sale on record, offering 980 million shares at $83 each before trading opened 34% higher at $111.50.
sents.ko: 이런 배경에서 앤스로픽이 목요일 나스닥에 데뷔했어요. DW는 역대 최대 규모의 주식 매각이라 했고, 9억 8천만 주를 주당 83달러에 내놓았으며 거래는 34% 오른 111.50달러에 시작됐어요.

sents.en: The opening price valued the five-year-old company at roughly $2 trillion, well above market estimates of about $1.3 trillion, while the Guardian put its expected value at $1.5 trillion despite reported losses of $80 billion in the first half of 2026.
sents.ko: 시초가는 5년 된 이 회사의 가치를 약 2조 달러로 매겨 시장 추정치인 약 1조 3천억 달러를 크게 웃돌았고, 가디언은 올해 상반기 800억 달러 손실에도 기대 가치를 1조 5천억 달러로 전했어요.

sents.en: The BBC reported that about $81 billion of shares were offered to the public and a further $26 billion to other big technology companies, comfortably the biggest money-raising event in American corporate history, with orders reportedly more than six times the shares on offer.
sents.ko: BBC에 따르면 약 810억 달러어치가 일반에 나왔고 260억 달러어치가 다른 대형 기술 기업에 돌아가 미국 기업 역사상 단연 최대 자금 조달이었으며, 주문은 물량의 6배를 넘은 것으로 알려졌어요.

sents.en: Analysts at StoneX described it as the first chance for public investors to buy a pure play on an AI provider, since earlier listings concerned chip makers and data centre builders.
sents.ko: 스톤엑스의 분석가는 앞선 상장이 반도체 업체와 데이터센터 건설업체였기에, 일반 투자자가 AI 업체 자체에 순수하게 투자할 첫 기회라고 설명했어요.

paragraphs.en: The listing arrives as confidence has wobbled: DW said many AI stocks hit record highs in the first half of the year, but the Magnificent Seven lost more than $1 trillion in value in a single trading day after the Democrats won control of Congress in the midterm elections. The BBC added that shares in CoreWeave and Nebius, which supply raw computing power, have lost about half their value, and that Nvidia, down 30%, or $2 trillion, from its peak, has lost its crown as the world's most valuable company. Nvidia's chief executive, Jensen Huang, resigned last week, DW reported, sending the chipmaker's shares lower still. OpenAI, maker of ChatGPT, has delayed its own listing until next year, and DW noted that some analysts wonder whether Anthropic has chosen the best moment.
paragraphs.ko: 상장은 신뢰가 흔들리는 때 이뤄졌어요. 중간선거 뒤 매그니피센트 7이 하루에 1조 달러 넘게 잃었고, 코어위브와 네비우스는 절반가량, 엔비디아는 정점 대비 30%(2조 달러) 떨어졌어요. 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO는 지난주 사임했고, 오픈AI는 상장을 내년으로 미뤘어요.

sents.en: The listing arrives as confidence has wobbled: DW said many AI stocks hit record highs in the first half of the year, but the Magnificent Seven lost more than $1 trillion in value in a single trading day after the Democrats won control of Congress in the midterm elections.
sents.ko: 상장은 신뢰가 흔들리는 때 이뤄졌어요. DW에 따르면 올 상반기에 많은 AI 주식이 사상 최고가를 냈지만, 민주당이 중간선거에서 의회 다수를 차지한 뒤 매그니피센트 7이 하루 만에 1조 달러 넘게 가치를 잃었어요.

sents.en: The BBC added that shares in CoreWeave and Nebius, which supply raw computing power, have lost about half their value, and that Nvidia, down 30%, or $2 trillion, from its peak, has lost its crown as the world's most valuable company.
sents.ko: BBC는 컴퓨팅 능력을 공급하는 코어위브와 네비우스의 주가가 절반가량 떨어졌고, 엔비디아가 정점 대비 30%, 2조 달러 하락해 세계에서 가장 비싼 회사 자리를 잃었다고 덧붙였어요.

sents.en: Nvidia's chief executive, Jensen Huang, resigned last week, DW reported, sending the chipmaker's shares lower still.
sents.ko: DW는 엔비디아 최고경영자 젠슨 황이 지난주 사임해 주가가 더 떨어졌다고 전했어요.

sents.en: OpenAI, maker of ChatGPT, has delayed its own listing until next year, and DW noted that some analysts wonder whether Anthropic has chosen the best moment.
sents.ko: 챗GPT를 만든 오픈AI는 상장을 내년으로 미뤘고, DW는 일부 분석가가 앤스로픽이 최적의 시점을 골랐는지 의문을 갖는다고 전했어요.

paragraphs.en: Valuation is the sharpest worry, and DW quoted Dennis Dick of Stock Trader Network as saying a company with $52 billion in current revenue looks overvalued unless it can reach the more than $600 billion that Goldman Sachs forecasts by 2030. Goldman estimated in September that hyperscalers need about $300 billion in annual AI revenue to break even, leaving a gap of roughly $230 billion, and expects them to spend $1.2 trillion in 2027 and $1.4 trillion in 2028 after about $800 billion this year. Borrowing costs for CoreWeave and Oracle have soared, the cost of insuring Nvidia's debt against default has risen 76% in a month according to CNBC, and Oracle, Meta, Microsoft and Alphabet have still announced $67 billion of new AI bond deals since the end of last month. Gary Marcus, a professor emeritus at New York University, argued earlier this year that the economics do not add up, since more companies building models makes the technology a commodity and drives prices down.
paragraphs.ko: 가치 평가가 가장 큰 걱정이에요. 매출 520억 달러 회사가 골드만삭스의 2030년 6,000억 달러 전망을 못 채우면 고평가라는 지적이 나왔어요. 골드만은 손익분기에 연 3,000억 달러가 필요해 2,300억 달러가 모자라다고 봤고, 차입 비용은 치솟았지만 대형 업체는 670억 달러어치 채권을 계속 냈어요.

sents.en: Valuation is the sharpest worry, and DW quoted Dennis Dick of Stock Trader Network as saying a company with $52 billion in current revenue looks overvalued unless it can reach the more than $600 billion that Goldman Sachs forecasts by 2030.
sents.ko: 가치 평가가 가장 날카로운 걱정거리예요. DW는 스톡트레이더네트워크의 데니스 딕이 현재 매출 520억 달러인 회사는 골드만삭스가 2030년까지 전망한 6,000억 달러를 넘기지 못하면 고평가로 보인다고 말했다고 전했어요.

sents.en: Goldman estimated in September that hyperscalers need about $300 billion in annual AI revenue to break even, leaving a gap of roughly $230 billion, and expects them to spend $1.2 trillion in 2027 and $1.4 trillion in 2028 after about $800 billion this year.
sents.ko: 골드만삭스는 9월에 대형 클라우드 업체가 손익분기점을 넘기려면 연간 AI 매출이 약 3,000억 달러 필요해 약 2,300억 달러가 모자란다고 추산했고, 올해 약 8,000억 달러 뒤 2027년 1조 2천억 달러, 2028년 1조 4천억 달러를 쓸 것으로 봤어요.

sents.en: Borrowing costs for CoreWeave and Oracle have soared, the cost of insuring Nvidia's debt against default has risen 76% in a month according to CNBC, and Oracle, Meta, Microsoft and Alphabet have still announced $67 billion of new AI bond deals since the end of last month.
sents.ko: 코어위브와 오라클의 차입 비용은 급등했고, CNBC에 따르면 엔비디아 부채의 부도 보험 비용은 한 달 새 76% 올랐지만, 오라클 · 메타 · 마이크로소프트 · 알파벳은 지난달 말 이후에도 670억 달러의 새 AI 채권을 발표했어요.

sents.en: Gary Marcus, a professor emeritus at New York University, argued earlier this year that the economics do not add up, since more companies building models makes the technology a commodity and drives prices down.
sents.ko: 뉴욕대 명예교수 게리 마커스는 올해 초 더 많은 회사가 모델을 만들수록 기술이 일반 상품이 되고 가격이 내려가므로 경제성이 맞지 않는다고 주장했어요.

paragraphs.en: Others see a correction rather than a collapse: Kit Rees of Quilter called the post-election rout healthy and said the build-out is still in its early innings, while Eileen Burbidge of Passion Capital told the BBC the bubble's growth may have slowed but is not about to burst. At a Korea Economic Daily roundtable, Owen Lamont of Acadian Asset Management said US stocks are probably in a bubble comparable to 1999 and 2000, citing high valuations, accelerating share issuance and heavy retail inflows, though he said that does not mean the market has peaked. He pointed to a cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio of 40.7 in October against a record of 44.2 in December 1999, and expects hundreds of small IPOs to follow Anthropic's. Economist Gary Smith warns of a frightful crash in an upcoming book, while Joachim Klement of Panmure Liberum expects a reckoning in 2027 or 2028, and the dot-com crash cut the Nasdaq's value by nearly 80%.
paragraphs.ko: 일부는 붕괴가 아니라 조정으로 봐요. 퀼터의 키트 리스는 건전한 조정이라 했고 버비지는 곧 터지지 않는다고 했어요. 러몬트는 1999~2000년과 비슷한 거품이 아마 맞다고 했고, 클레멘트는 2027~2028년에 청산이 온다고 보며, 닷컴 붕괴 때 나스닥은 거의 80% 빠졌어요.

sents.en: Others see a correction rather than a collapse: Kit Rees of Quilter called the post-election rout healthy and said the build-out is still in its early innings, while Eileen Burbidge of Passion Capital told the BBC the bubble's growth may have slowed but is not about to burst.
sents.ko: 다른 이들은 붕괴가 아닌 조정으로 봐요. 퀼터의 키트 리스는 선거 뒤 급락을 건전하다고 했고 건설이 아직 초반이라 했으며, 패션캐피털의 아일린 버비지는 BBC에 거품의 성장이 둔해졌을 뿐 곧 터지지는 않는다고 했어요.

sents.en: At a Korea Economic Daily roundtable, Owen Lamont of Acadian Asset Management said US stocks are probably in a bubble comparable to 1999 and 2000, citing high valuations, accelerating share issuance and heavy retail inflows, though he said that does not mean the market has peaked.
sents.ko: 한국경제신문 라운드테이블에서 아카디안자산운용의 오언 러몬트는 높은 평가, 늘어나는 신주 발행, 개인 자금 유입을 들어 미국 증시가 1999~2000년과 비슷한 거품일 가능성이 크지만 정점이라는 뜻은 아니라고 했어요.

sents.en: He pointed to a cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio of 40.7 in October against a record of 44.2 in December 1999, and expects hundreds of small IPOs to follow Anthropic's.
sents.ko: 그는 10월 경기조정 주가수익비율이 40.7로 1999년 12월의 기록 44.2에 다가섰다고 짚었고, 앤스로픽 뒤로 작은 상장이 수백 건 이어질 것으로 예상했어요.

sents.en: Economist Gary Smith warns of a frightful crash in an upcoming book, while Joachim Klement of Panmure Liberum expects a reckoning in 2027 or 2028, and the dot-com crash cut the Nasdaq's value by nearly 80%.
sents.ko: 경제학자 게리 스미스는 곧 나올 책에서 끔찍한 폭락을 경고하고, 판뮤어리버럼의 요아힘 클레멘트는 2027년이나 2028년에 청산이 온다고 보며, 닷컴 붕괴 때 나스닥은 가치가 거의 80% 줄었어요.

paragraphs.en: The European Central Bank said in its November Financial Stability Review that risks stem from AI valuations, fiscal imbalances and geoeconomic tensions, and that ambitious earnings expectations leave markets vulnerable to abrupt adjustments. Vice-President Boris Vujčić said risks remain elevated, adding that euro area banks are well placed to withstand shocks while vulnerabilities are more pronounced in certain non-banks. The ECB warned that AI infrastructure is increasingly funded through debt, so a change in sentiment could spread losses from equity markets to bond markets, and the Guardian said it drew historic parallels with the dot-com bubble and the sub-prime bubble behind the 2008 crisis. A November working paper from the National Bureau of Economic Research by Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh and Zijin Su found that debt finances nearly 60% of the expansion, and that in a low-productivity scenario losses would reach $16.8 trillion across shareholders and creditors.
paragraphs.ko: ECB는 금융안정보고서에서 AI 가치 평가, 재정 불균형, 지정학 긴장을 위험으로 꼽고 AI 인프라가 부채로 조달돼 손실이 채권시장으로 번질 수 있다고 경고했어요. 부이치치 부총재는 은행은 튼튼하지만 일부 비은행이 취약하다고 했어요. NBER 논문은 부채가 확장의 거의 60%를 대고 최악의 경우 손실이 16조 8천억 달러라고 봤어요.

sents.en: The European Central Bank said in its November Financial Stability Review that risks stem from AI valuations, fiscal imbalances and geoeconomic tensions, and that ambitious earnings expectations leave markets vulnerable to abrupt adjustments.
sents.ko: 유럽중앙은행은 11월 금융안정보고서에서 위험이 AI 가치 평가, 재정 불균형, 지정학 긴장에서 나오며 야심 찬 이익 기대가 시장을 급격한 조정에 취약하게 만든다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: Vice-President Boris Vujčić said risks remain elevated, adding that euro area banks are well placed to withstand shocks while vulnerabilities are more pronounced in certain non-banks.
sents.ko: 보리스 부이치치 부총재는 위험이 높은 수준이라면서도 유로존 은행은 충격을 견딜 여건이 좋고 일부 비은행에서 취약성이 더 두드러진다고 말했어요.

sents.en: The ECB warned that AI infrastructure is increasingly funded through debt, so a change in sentiment could spread losses from equity markets to bond markets, and the Guardian said it drew historic parallels with the dot-com bubble and the sub-prime bubble behind the 2008 crisis.
sents.ko: ECB는 AI 인프라가 점점 부채로 조달돼 분위기가 바뀌면 손실이 주식시장에서 채권시장으로 번질 수 있다고 경고했고, 가디언은 닷컴 거품과 2008년 위기를 부른 서브프라임 거품과의 역사적 유사성을 언급했다고 전했어요.

sents.en: A November working paper from the National Bureau of Economic Research by Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh and Zijin Su found that debt finances nearly 60% of the expansion, and that in a low-productivity scenario losses would reach $16.8 trillion across shareholders and creditors.
sents.ko: 전미경제연구소의 11월 워킹페이퍼에서 스테인 판니우어뷔르흐와 수 쯔진은 부채가 확장의 거의 60%를 대고, 생산성이 낮은 시나리오에서는 주주와 채권자 손실이 16조 8천억 달러에 이른다고 밝혔어요.

paragraphs.en: The International Monetary Fund's managing director, Kristalina Georgieva, told the Apec summit in Shenzhen that booming demand for AI hardware and related products is pushing up consumer prices, and that together with the energy shock from the war in the Middle East this calls for tighter monetary policy in many economies. She said the two factors would push global inflation to 4.7% this year, and that AI hardware and related tech products now make up more than one-tenth of world goods trade, a share that is rising rapidly. Central banks have already raised rates this year after the war that began in February pushed oil above $100 a barrel: the ECB in June, the Federal Reserve in September and the Bank of England earlier this month, and markets expect more increases next year. Georgieva said the energy shock will eventually fade but that AI is forever, and she warned that countries need digital infrastructure, ready workers and risk mitigation, summing it up as: you snooze, you lose.
paragraphs.ko: IMF 총재는 APEC에서 AI 하드웨어 수요가 물가를 밀어올려 많은 나라에서 긴축이 필요하다고 했어요. 올해 세계 물가 상승률은 4.7%, AI 제품은 세계 상품 무역의 10분의 1 넘게 차지해요. 중앙은행들은 이미 올렸고 시장은 내년 추가 인상을 예상해요. 그는 AI는 영원하다며 준비를 강조했어요.

sents.en: The International Monetary Fund's managing director, Kristalina Georgieva, told the Apec summit in Shenzhen that booming demand for AI hardware and related products is pushing up consumer prices, and that together with the energy shock from the war in the Middle East this calls for tighter monetary policy in many economies.
sents.ko: 국제통화기금 총재 크리스탈리나 게오르기에바는 선전 APEC 정상회의에서 AI 하드웨어와 관련 제품 수요 급증이 소비자 물가를 밀어올리고 있으며, 중동 전쟁발 에너지 충격과 합쳐져 많은 경제에서 통화 긴축이 필요하다고 말했어요.

sents.en: She said the two factors would push global inflation to 4.7% this year, and that AI hardware and related tech products now make up more than one-tenth of world goods trade, a share that is rising rapidly.
sents.ko: 그는 두 요인이 올해 세계 물가 상승률을 4.7%로 끌어올릴 것이며, AI 하드웨어와 관련 기술 제품이 이제 세계 상품 무역의 10분의 1 넘게 차지하고 그 몫이 빠르게 늘고 있다고 했어요.

sents.en: Central banks have already raised rates this year after the war that began in February pushed oil above $100 a barrel: the ECB in June, the Federal Reserve in September and the Bank of England earlier this month, and markets expect more increases next year.
sents.ko: 2월에 시작된 전쟁으로 유가가 배럴당 100달러를 넘은 뒤 중앙은행들은 올해 이미 금리를 올렸어요. ECB는 6월, 연준은 9월, 영국은행은 이달 초였고 시장은 내년에 추가 인상을 예상해요.

sents.en: Georgieva said the energy shock will eventually fade but that AI is forever, and she warned that countries need digital infrastructure, ready workers and risk mitigation, summing it up as: you snooze, you lose.
sents.ko: 게오르기에바는 에너지 충격은 결국 가라앉지만 AI는 영원하다고 말했고, 각국에 디지털 인프라와 준비된 노동자, 위험 완화가 필요하다며 꾸물대면 진다고 요약했어요.

paragraphs.en: Some of the strain is visible in the market for AI customers: Ramp's lead economist Ara Kharazian, who tracks AI spending at more than 85,000 US businesses, told France 24 that much of the boom has been driven by the top 1 percent of companies using the technology. He added that fierce competition has led model developers to cut prices significantly, and that customers are now weighing whether cheaper, lighter models can meet their needs, even as some leading technology firms begin to trim AI spending. At a Morgan Stanley conference in Singapore on Nov. 18, Kim Yong-kwan, who heads corporate management strategy at Samsung Electronics' chip division, said neocloud companies account for only about 8% of the AI market, so concerns over their debt should not threaten overall growth. He called today's investment a structural trend backed by long-term contracts between chip makers and customers, saying it is based on real demand rather than the speculation that caused oversupply in past semiconductor cycles, as Business Korea reported.
paragraphs.ko: 램프의 경제학자는 호황이 상위 1% 기업이 이끌었고 모델 가격이 크게 내려 고객이 더 싼 모델을 따져 본다고 했어요. 삼성전자 김용관 사장은 11월 18일 싱가포르에서 네오클라우드가 AI 시장의 약 8%라 부채 우려가 성장을 위협하지 않으며 투자는 실제 수요에 기반한다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Some of the strain is visible in the market for AI customers: Ramp's lead economist Ara Kharazian, who tracks AI spending at more than 85,000 US businesses, told France 24 that much of the boom has been driven by the top 1 percent of companies using the technology.
sents.ko: AI 고객 시장에서도 긴장이 보여요. 미국 기업 8만 5천 곳 넘는 AI 지출을 추적하는 램프의 수석 경제학자 아라 카라지안은 프랑스24에 호황의 상당 부분이 기술을 쓰는 상위 1% 기업에서 나왔다고 말했어요.

sents.en: He added that fierce competition has led model developers to cut prices significantly, and that customers are now weighing whether cheaper, lighter models can meet their needs, even as some leading technology firms begin to trim AI spending.
sents.ko: 그는 치열한 경쟁으로 모델 개발사들이 값을 크게 낮췄고, 일부 주요 기술 기업이 AI 지출을 줄이기 시작한 가운데 고객들이 더 싼 가벼운 모델로 충분한지 따져 본다고 덧붙였어요.

sents.en: At a Morgan Stanley conference in Singapore on Nov. 18, Kim Yong-kwan, who heads corporate management strategy at Samsung Electronics' chip division, said neocloud companies account for only about 8% of the AI market, so concerns over their debt should not threaten overall growth.
sents.ko: 11월 18일 싱가포르 모건스탠리 콘퍼런스에서 삼성전자 DS부문 경영전략총괄 김용관 사장은 네오클라우드 업체가 AI 시장의 약 8%뿐이라 이들의 부채 우려가 전체 성장을 위협하지 않을 것이라고 말했어요.

sents.en: He called today's investment a structural trend backed by long-term contracts between chip makers and customers, saying it is based on real demand rather than the speculation that caused oversupply in past semiconductor cycles, as Business Korea reported.
sents.ko: 비즈니스코리아에 따르면 그는 오늘의 투자가 반도체 업체와 고객 사이의 장기 계약에 받쳐진 구조적 추세이며 과거 반도체 주기에 공급 과잉을 낳은 투기가 아니라 실제 수요에 기반한다고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: For Korea the stakes are close to home, because KED Global noted that Korean investors have poured money into US technology shares and that Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix drove the Kospi's strong performance through the first half of 2026. Howard Marks of Oaktree Capital said AI could become the most transformative force in the global economy but that investors struggle to determine what AI companies are worth. Theodore Koenig of Monroe Capital warned about loans of five to 10 years that finance graphics chips which may be outdated within two or three years, and noted that data centre lending faces risks from electricity, water and community opposition. The next tests are the first weeks of Anthropic's trading, whether more AI companies follow it to market, and whether central banks lift rates again next year.
paragraphs.ko: 한국 투자자들은 미국 기술주에 큰돈을 넣었고 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 올 상반기 코스피를 이끌었어요. 하워드 막스는 AI 기업 가치를 가늠하기 어렵다고 했고, 쾨니그는 빨리 낡을 칩을 장기 대출로 사는 일을 경고했어요. 앞으로는 앤스로픽 거래, 후속 상장, 내년 금리를 봐야 해요.

sents.en: For Korea the stakes are close to home, because KED Global noted that Korean investors have poured money into US technology shares and that Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix drove the Kospi's strong performance through the first half of 2026.
sents.ko: 한국에는 남의 일이 아니에요. KED글로벌은 한국 투자자들이 미국 기술주에 큰돈을 넣었고 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 2026년 상반기 코스피의 강세를 이끌었다고 전했어요.

sents.en: Howard Marks of Oaktree Capital said AI could become the most transformative force in the global economy but that investors struggle to determine what AI companies are worth.
sents.ko: 오크트리캐피털의 하워드 막스는 AI가 세계 경제에서 가장 큰 변혁의 힘이 될 수 있지만 투자자가 AI 기업의 가치를 가늠하기 어렵다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Theodore Koenig of Monroe Capital warned about loans of five to 10 years that finance graphics chips which may be outdated within two or three years, and noted that data centre lending faces risks from electricity, water and community opposition.
sents.ko: 먼로캐피털의 시어도어 쾨니그는 2~3년이면 구식이 될 수 있는 그래픽 칩을 5~10년 만기 대출로 사는 데 대해 경고했고, 데이터센터 대출이 전력, 물, 지역 반대의 위험을 안는다고 지적했어요.

sents.en: The next tests are the first weeks of Anthropic's trading, whether more AI companies follow it to market, and whether central banks lift rates again next year.
sents.ko: 다음 시험대는 앤스로픽 거래 첫 몇 주, 더 많은 AI 기업이 뒤따라 상장할지, 내년에 중앙은행이 금리를 다시 올릴지예요.

views.view: Critics have showered the game with near-universal praise, and a 99 Metacritic average makes it the highest-rated game ever.
Analysts call GTA 6 a cultural happening, but an economist says staff absences should not cause major economic disruption.
Take-Two is poised for nearly $2 billion in first-day sales, though its chief executive stopped short of declaring victory.
A Rockstar animation programmer says the world's biggest game should come with union recognition and better working conditions.
Downing Street hailed the game as a British success story but said the prime minister will not play it.
Athletes and teams counted down to the release, and one NBA player joked that league performances could drop in November.

talk.qKo: GTA 6 같은 거대한 콘텐츠 출시에 맞춰 학교와 직장이 일정을 조정해야 할까요?
talk.answer: Some employers gave staff time off, while Downing Street said students should be in classrooms. I think flexibility for adults makes sense if the work still gets done, but school attendance matters more. A launch is a moment, not a reason to skip class.

paragraphs.en: Grand Theft Auto VI completed a phased worldwide rollout on Thursday, ending a 13-year wait for the next entry in Rockstar Games' blockbuster franchise and drawing near-universal praise from critics. Metacritic calculated an average score of 99 out of 100 from 150 reviews, and it confirmed to the BBC that the game had overtaken The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, which had held the top spot since 1998. Set in the fictional US state of Leonida, the game follows two protagonists, Lucia and Jason, through the seedy underbelly of America after an easy score goes wrong. The Guardian's Keza MacDonald praised the relationship between the leads, saying there is still a lot of sexism in the game's world but that this is the first title in the series in which women are treated as people.
paragraphs.ko: GTA 6이 13년의 기다림 끝에 전 세계 출시를 마쳤고, 평론가들이 극찬했어요. 메타크리틱 평균은 99점으로 역대 최고예요.

sents.en: Grand Theft Auto VI completed a phased worldwide rollout on Thursday, ending a 13-year wait for the next entry in Rockstar Games' blockbuster franchise and drawing near-universal praise from critics.
sents.ko: 그랜드 테프트 오토 6가 목요일 단계적 전 세계 출시를 마쳐, 록스타 게임스의 대형 시리즈 신작을 기다린 13년이 끝났고 평론가들의 거의 만장일치에 가까운 찬사를 받았어요.

sents.en: Metacritic calculated an average score of 99 out of 100 from 150 reviews, and it confirmed to the BBC that the game had overtaken The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, which had held the top spot since 1998.
sents.ko: 메타크리틱은 150건의 평가로 평균 99점을 산출했고, 1998년부터 1위였던 젤다의 전설: 시간의 오카리나를 이 게임이 넘어섰다고 BBC에 확인해 줬어요.

sents.en: Set in the fictional US state of Leonida, the game follows two protagonists, Lucia and Jason, through the seedy underbelly of America after an easy score goes wrong.
sents.ko: 가상의 미국 주 레오니다를 배경으로, 쉬운 한탕이 틀어진 뒤 두 주인공 루시아와 제이슨이 미국의 어두운 이면을 헤쳐 나가는 이야기예요.

sents.en: The Guardian's Keza MacDonald praised the relationship between the leads, saying there is still a lot of sexism in the game's world but that this is the first title in the series in which women are treated as people.
sents.ko: 가디언의 케자 맥도널드는 두 주인공의 관계를 칭찬하며, 게임 세계에 여전히 성차별이 많지만 시리즈 중 처음으로 여성이 사람으로 대우받는 작품이라고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: The game was released at midnight in every country where it is available, which meant New Zealanders were the first to play it. Aleana Fernando of Auckland told BBC Newsbeat soon after starting that the graphics were great, even from the set-up and credits. When it opened at midnight UK time, Charlie Wood of London said he had laughed at the dialogue before even reaching the gameplay and, about 30 minutes in, called it "most definitely worth the wait." In Germany, a player named Timur said the number of in-game encounters made it feel like a life simulation. Players could pre-download the 212GB game, some bought a new console just for it, and Virgin Media O2, BT and EE said internet traffic records were broken in the days before the UK release.
paragraphs.ko: 뉴질랜드 이용자들이 가장 먼저 즐겼고, 각국 첫 이용자들이 반응을 전했어요. 접속 폭주로 통신 기록도 깨졌어요.

sents.en: The game was released at midnight in every country where it is available, which meant New Zealanders were the first to play it.
sents.ko: 게임은 출시 국가마다 자정에 풀려, 뉴질랜드 사람들이 가장 먼저 즐기게 됐어요.

sents.en: Aleana Fernando of Auckland told BBC Newsbeat soon after starting that the graphics were great, even from the set-up and credits.
sents.ko: 오클랜드의 알레아나 페르난도는 시작하자마자 BBC 뉴스비트에, 설정 화면과 크레딧부터 그래픽이 훌륭하다고 말했어요.

sents.en: When it opened at midnight UK time, Charlie Wood of London said he had laughed at the dialogue before even reaching the gameplay and, about 30 minutes in, called it "most definitely worth the wait."
sents.ko: 영국 시간 자정에 열리자 런던의 찰리 우드는 본격적인 플레이에 들어가기도 전에 대사에 웃었고, 30분쯤 뒤에는 "기다린 보람이 확실히 있다"고 했어요.

sents.en: In Germany, a player named Timur said the number of in-game encounters made it feel like a life simulation.
sents.ko: 독일의 티무르라는 이용자는 게임 속 만남이 워낙 많아 생활 시뮬레이션 같다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Players could pre-download the 212GB game, some bought a new console just for it, and Virgin Media O2, BT and EE said internet traffic records were broken in the days before the UK release.
sents.ko: 이용자들은 212GB짜리 게임을 미리 내려받을 수 있었고 일부는 이 게임만을 위해 새 콘솔을 샀으며, 버진 미디어 O2, BT, EE는 영국 출시 전 며칠간 인터넷 트래픽 기록이 깨졌다고 밝혔어요.

paragraphs.en: Kieran Youens-Byrne, 34, of Manchester said he was going on a pilgrimage to Wales, completely off grid for a week, adding that his partner Clare had been incredibly understanding. In Kansas City, Cameron Logan Cox, a 34-year-old filmmaker and creative director at a music label, wrote simply "GTA 6" on his request for paid time off, and his coworkers already knew he was a huge gamer. According to payroll processor Gusto, requests for paid time off on the game's commercial release day were up 9 percent compared with the two prior weeks. Bart Spiegel, a PwC partner who leads its global entertainment and media practice, said the anticipation was on another level and the moment could rival the Olympics in the attention it commands. A 27-year-old postal clerk in Grays Harbor, Washington, requested her leave in March, pre-downloaded the game and planned to play through the night starting at 9 p.m. PST on Wednesday to avoid spoilers. A 25-year-old tech finance worker in the UK, who asked not to be named, took a long weekend and set up his PlayStation account to appear to be in New Zealand so he could start earlier.
paragraphs.ko: 팬들은 출시일에 휴가를 냈어요. 급여 업체 자료로 휴가 신청이 늘었어요.

sents.ko: 급여 처리 업체 거스토에 따르면 게임 정식 출시일의 유급 휴가 신청은 앞선 2주보다 9% 늘었어요.

sents.en: Bart Spiegel, a PwC partner who leads its global entertainment and media practice, said the anticipation was on another level and the moment could rival the Olympics in the attention it commands.
